name: Lively Places Fund (URA / HDB)
overlap_rule: Existing projects which are receiving other forms of funding from other agencies are not eligible for the Fund.

criteria.text: Applicants sign up as an individual or a team of Singapore Citizens/PRs, at least one above 17

criteria.improvement: Make the event free to attend: drop ticket sales and cover costs with the grant and in-kind support.
Add a resident co-creation session where neighbours make part of the work shown on site.

criteria.text: The space stays accessible to the public at all times
Request fits the cap: up to $5,000 for an activation of 6 months or less ($20,000 if longer); NAC can add artist fees

name: Presentation and Participation Grant (NAC)
overlap_rule: Declare other government funding for the same activity; NAC may not fund costs already supported elsewhere.

criteria.text: Applicant is a Singapore Citizen/PR, a registered organisation, or a collective with a majority of local members
Shows how audiences or residents take part, not only watch
criteria.improvement: Have workshop participants make lanterns that become part of the installation, credited on site.

criteria.text: Applied within an NAC application cycle, before the project starts

name: WeCare Arts Fund (NAC with CDCs)
overlap_rule: Projects that have already started are not supported; declare other government funding.

criteria.text: Project serves beneficiaries of a social service partner (e.g. seniors, persons with disabilities)
Participants take part in making art, not only as audience
criteria.improvement: Run the workshop with a nearby Active Ageing Centre so seniors make work for the event.

criteria.text: Project has not started when applying
